DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 106 s. 2022 September 28, 2022 DIR. PAISAL O. ABUTAZIL Regional Director, DILG-Region IX President Corazon C. Aquino Regional Government Center Brgy. Balintawak, Pagadian City Dear RD Abutazil: This refers to your Memorandum dated August 19, 2022 seeking the Central Office's legal opinion on whether or not seminars/trainings charging registration fees per barangay can be carried out even without appropriate authority. From your Memorandum, we culled the following antecedent facts: 1. In a letter dated I August 2022, MLGOO Hja. Fatma S. Apuaca-Hamin reported the activities conducted by the MDRRMO in Sirawai, Zamboanga del Norte, to wit: 1.1 1.2 Seminars/Trainings on Swift Water and Flood Rescue (SwAFR) on July 20-22, 2022 for barangay officials and collected therefor registration fees amounting to Sixteen Thousand Pesos (Php 16,000) per barangay (for 2 pax) using the Official Receipt (OR) of Disaster and Emergency Training Center of Dipolog City; and A 3-day Seminar on Basic Self-Defense on July 28-30, 2022 collecting therefor registration fees in the amount of Thirteen Thousand Pesos (Php 13,000) per barangay for every 3 BPTAs using Official Receipts of Action Bridges Aspirations (ABA) Trainings, Inc. with expired validity 2. Hence, your request for legal opinion. In this regard, please be informed that the Department recently issued an Advisory dated August 10, 2022 and Pagpapayo dated August 15, 2022, advising all Regional Directors to observe the pertinent provision of DILG Circular No. 2020-19 dated July 14, 2020, and states that: "The issuance of authority for the conduct of conventions, seminars, and other similar activities intended for barangay and SK officials are within the authority of the Regional Director, if the requesting party is within the regional jurisdiction regardless of the location or venue." "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Upon further evaluation, the alleged activities reported by the concerned MLGOO were all substantiated by proofs such as a copy of receipt and a copy of the MDRRMO Memorandum 22-003 with the subject pertaining to the seminar, and proof of program of activities, among others. In view thereof, it is recommended that you coordinate with the Municipal Mayor of Sirawai, Zamboanga del Norte to inform the latter about the activities and possible violations committed by the MDRRMO. Let it be noted that the MDRRMO is an appointee of the Municipal Mayor. Section 1, Rule 6 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 10121 or the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act df 2010 (PDRRM Act of 2010) provides: "Section 1. Establishment of an Office—There is hereby created an LDRRMO in every province, city and municipality under the Office of the Governor, City or Municipal Mayor, respectively, and a Barangay Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Committee (BDRRMC) in every barangay to be headed by the Punong barangay." This should be read in relation to Section 77 of RA 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 which states that the chief executive of every local government unit shall be responsible for human resources and development in his unit and shall take all personnel actions in accordance with the Constitutional provisions on civil service, pertinent laws, and rules and regulations thereon, including such policies, guidelines and standards as the Civil Service Commission may establish. Please be guided accordingly. Thank you. Veryvtruly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: A TY. Under VICTO R.
